motds.title: Watchlist Updated!
motds.message:
I want to keep filling the list of NPC's and their coordinates.

Please, if you see a missing NPC, stand exactly on top of it and report the Node with the name of the NPC.

Thank you!

motds.title: Welcome to Tyrian Lens!
motds.message: Tyrian Lens version 1.3.9 is now live! Thank you for using our premium GPS overlay companion. Check the settings panel on the top-right overlay to sync your API tokens.

motds.title: App localization
motds.message:
Tyrian Lens in now available in multiple languages.

The entire app is mostly translated in German, French & Spanish.

Select your preferred language in the settings


If you encounter missing text or wrong translations, please report this in the
Bug reports
or join the Discord Server.
